'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Josh Mack LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Day 2 name box is Mack.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
